name: lanlink
description: 内置 EasyTier 核心的跨平台一键局域网联机工具

scripts.build:server: mkdir -p packages/server/dist && cd packages/server && GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags "-s -w" -o dist/lanlink-rooms-linux-amd64 .
scripts.build:server:arm64: mkdir -p packages/server/dist && cd packages/server && GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags "-s -w" -o dist/lanlink-rooms-linux-arm64 .
